pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with moderate edge angularity. Spatial area of individual patches is relatively consistent across the mid-flank. Pixel gradients at patch boundaries are soft, likely due to image resolution and focus.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of off-white inter-patch spacing. Topological graph consists of junction nodes primarily with three-way and four-way intersections. Pathway thickness varies from narrow constraints to wider nodal expansions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the neck and back ridge, where individual hair clusters form a jagged silhouette against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: No structural gaps in the mane are visible, though the continuity is locally occluded by the presence of a bird on the upper shoulder.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized group of small, dark, punctate marks or textural disruptions on the lower-mid flank, appearing as focal skin depressions.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark-plumaged avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck.
